Name: Only Entities
Description: Do an entity update from .map to .bsp, without rebuilding geometry.
Warning: Requires a previously compiled .bsp of the same map.

Name: No WAD Textures
Description: Include all used textures into the BSP instead of relying on external WAD files at runtime.

Name: WAD Include
Description: Include a specific WAD or directory into the BSP.

Name: No WAD Autodetect
Description: Disable auto-detection of WAD files (SDHLT enables wad autodetect by default regardless of other settings).

Name: No Clip
Description: Don't create the clipping hull.
Warning: HLBSP must also be run with -noclip if used here.

Name: Clip Economy
Description: Turn clipnode economy mode on.

Name: Clip Type
Description: Clip hull generation method: legacy (default), normalized, simple, precise, or smallest.

Name: Null File
Description: Specify a list of entities to retexture with NULL.

Name: No Sky Clip
Description: Disable automatic clipping of SKY brushes.

Name: Tiny
Description: Minimum brush face surface area before it is discarded.

Name: Brush Union Threshold
Description: Threshold to warn about overlapping brushes.
Warning: Slows down HLCSG considerably; leave unset for normal compiles.

Name: Hull File
Description: Reads in custom collision hull dimensions from a file.

Name: WAD Config File
Description: Specify a WAD configuration file.

Name: WAD Config
Description: Use the old wad configuration approach - selects a named group from wad.cfg.

Name: World Extent
Description: Extends the maximum map geometry bounds beyond the default +/-32768 units.

Name: Scale
Description: Scale the world.

Name: No Null Texture Strip
Description: Turns off NULL texture stripping.

Name: No Nullify Trigger
Description: Don't remove the 'aaatrigger' texture.

Name: No Light Opt
Description: Don't optimize engine light entities.

Name: No Text Convert
Description: Don't convert game_text message from Windows ANSI to UTF8 format.

Name: Texdata
Description: Alter the maximum texture memory limit, in KB.

Name: Lightdata
Description: Alter the maximum lighting memory limit, in KB.

Name: Chart
Description: Display BSP statistics.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLCSG as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLCSG as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: No Log
Description: Don't generate the compile logfiles.

Name: No Reset Log
Description: Do not delete the log file from previous compiles.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually specify the number of CPU threads to run.

Name: Estimate
Description: Display estimated time remaining during compile.

Name: Verbose
Description: Compile with verbose messages.

Name: No Info
Description: Do not show tool configuration information.

Name: Developer
Description: Compile with developer messages.

Name: Console
Description: Set to 0 to turn off the tool's pop-up console window (default is 1).
